facts.fact: Benin had 37.5 million e-money accounts, 11.2 million active, at the end of 2024, per the BCEAO report.

Benin's e-money users made 2.54 billion transactions in 2024, including 1.8 billion merchant payments worth CFA 1,618 billion and over 200 million person-to-person transfers worth CFA 3,104 billion, per the BCEAO.
